name: personal-memory
description: Your own verbatim, tamper-evident memory on your device. Claude recalls exact records instead of guessing.
long_description: Personal Memory keeps what you share about yourself with Claude, word for word, with date and time, in one file on your computer. Records are never edited: they are sealed in a tamper-evident chain, and later understanding is added next to the original. When you talk about yourself, Claude borrows a small relevant slice and can look up exact records instead of guessing. Automatic recording can be turned off; notes marked private are never shown to any AI; deleting a note has a 7-day cooling-off. No account, no cloud, no tracking. Free and open source. Not a medical or therapy product.

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Save what you share about yourself, word for word (automatically if you turned that on).

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Borrow a small, privacy-filtered overview of your memory relevant to this message.

tools.name: lookup
tools.description: Find exact original records with date, time and an integrity check.

tools.name: forget
tools.description: Hide a record now and delete it after a 7-day cooling-off (undo possible).

tools.name: memory_info
tools.description: Status and integrity, access log, export, pause or resume recording.

auto_record.title: Record automatically
auto_record.description: When you tell Claude about yourself, your words are kept automatically (you can say 'pause recording' any time). Off: only when you ask.

data_dir.title: Memory folder
data_dir.description: Where your memory file is kept. Back up or move this folder any time.

share_sensitive.title: Share notes marked sensitive
share_sensitive.description: Off by default. Notes marked private (restricted) are never shared, whatever this says.

budget.title: Memory per reply (tokens)
budget.description: The most memory Claude may borrow for one reply. Smaller shares less.
